case_name: Chairman School of Buddhist Philosophy,Leh,Ladakh(J and K) v Makhan Lal Matto And Anr
petitioner: Chairman School of Buddhist Philosophy,Leh,Ladakh(J and K)
holding: The qualifications for the post of Principal were validly revised by amending the Rules in August, 1978.
M.L. Mattoo does not possess the revised qualifications and is therefore not eligible to be considered for the said post.
The advertisement issued on January 5, 1982 was in accordance with the Rules and the High Court was not justified in quashing the same.
